gmcm.CycleTime.name: Cycle Time
gmcm.CycleTime.tooltip: How long, in milliseconds, to wait between each movement when automatically rotating the queue. Minimum 500.
gmcm.PauseTime.name: Pause Time
gmcm.PauseTime.tooltip: How long, in milliseconds, to wait after manually rotating the queue before resuming automatic rotation. Minimum 1000.
gmcm.StaggerDistance.name: Stagger Distance
gmcm.StaggerDistance.tooltip: How far, in screen pixels, each additional icon is offset from the main draw position.
gmcm.QueueBrightness.name: Queue Brightness
gmcm.QueueBrightness.tooltip: How brightly each additional icon is drawn.
gmcm.CycleSoundVolume.name: Cycle Sound Volume
gmcm.CycleSoundVolume.tooltip: How loudly to play the page sound effect when the queue is manually rotated. Set to 0 to disable the sound.
gmcm.AlwaysCycle.name: Always Cycle
gmcm.AlwaysCycle.tooltip: Whether to automatically rotate the queue even when not hovering over the date.
gmcm.InvertScrollDirection.name: Invert Scroll Direction
gmcm.InvertScrollDirection.tooltip: Whether to flip the default mapping of scroll wheel directions to texture cycle directions.
